scope: Event tools and their exact integration boundaries; no blanket claim about other owners or live acceptance

validation.latest_combined_result: 81 passed on the final frozen tool implementation with PostgreSQL typed constraints
targeted_followups: Actual PostgreSQL typed producer and bounded snapshot query tests passed
validation.live_claims: No live Telegram messages, credentials, unattended latency or soak acceptance claimed
validation.required_followup: SVC-24 exact job identity/priority/TTL regression: 2 passed, including actual PostgreSQL, after the 81-test combined validation. Source frozen again for root global formatting/final run.

findings.requirement: PRIMARY credibility uses the event ladder from APPROVED, while capture/exposure/certainty/tradability requirements remain in force.

Milestone source identity resolves from the immutable configured catalog even before reg.sources is materialized; MAJOR escalation uses all concerned entity official sources and durable source controls.
scope_limits: Exchange/regulator catalog contents and reg.* startup materialization belong to sources/runtime owners.

findings.requirement: Current D9 DuckDuckGo searches require no key and record each actual adapter attempt with zero cost/FREE billing; results retain raw JSON and title/URL/snippet evidence.
scope_limits: DDGS-only transport, global request spacing, retries and public-search smoke evidence belong to search.py owner. No live secrets or messaging are used by these tests.

findings.requirement: Quotes from durable Tank items returned by get_item/search_tank_items within the same session are admissible; items are fetched by explicit IDs rather than scanning all ingestion history.

LIVE+ is held at the stage supported by quoted evidence; announcements/future plans do not fabricate deployment, future opening timestamps are checked, and actual-trading artifact wording is recognized.
scope_limits: Quoted natural-language facts still originate with the analyst; this lexical validator is not a separate semantic truth model.

findings.requirement: C1 examines null measurable values and accepted mechanism evidence, so required-but-unknown Measured objects cannot evade the headline-only cap.
Exposure is numeric 0..10; layers without credible evidence require reasons and support explicit NONE/UNKNOWN; no-credible-secondary explanation is persisted.

FULL waits for truth/decisions for the complete analysis set, displays one primary/least-repriced credible secondary/next relevant secondary or loser, pins original FULL shown tokens, and never activates hidden analysis-only token calls.
scope_limits: Card composition and call activation/suppression are additionally enforced by cards.py and delivery.py owners.

findings.requirement: Expired calls yield an immutable tracking-ended lifecycle view without reopening trades; milestone resolutions remain pending until a matching SENT card consumes their marker.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/delivery.py matching milestone_resolution_id / expired_call_ids SENT handling

findings.requirement: Milestone resolution requires accepted primary claims and a verbatim official outcome quote, preserves resolution history, clears the pending milestone, and confirms source escalation.
scope_limits: A timer itself does not fabricate an outcome or quote; unresolved timer messages request analyst verification.

findings.requirement: Scout reviews persist all four supplied review scores, an allowed recommendation, and a semantic duplicate target; equivalent differently named proposals merge occurrence/evidence counts without automatic promotion.
scope_limits: No new score threshold or canonical taxonomy promotion is introduced. Human sandbox/promotion decisions remain outside this tool.

findings.requirement: Tool execution uses the current immutable config/code snapshot; old model/prompt/session versions remain separate and bundle provenance unions actual producing records/sessions instead of stamping the current model.
scope_limits: If the producing session exposes no deployed skill/agent version, the bundle retains null with an explicit unresolved-field reason; it never invents v1 or a current model. Live OpenMA deployment/version acceptance is a separate operator gate.

findings.requirement: Linter rewrite counting uses only the latest completed publish attempt for the same event and matching kind, rather than any earlier refusal in the session.
scope_limits: This narrow retry-scope change is source-inspected; no dedicated standalone retry-lineage regression is claimed. Normal strict publication and refusal paths are exercised by the listed publication tests.

findings.requirement: A bound analyst cannot create a second event or mutate another event; explicit merge targets remain allowed and unbound analysts must record their event first.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/agents/sessions.py persisted session mapping and tool-call idempotency

findings.requirement: CLOSED and MERGED events cannot publish new cards.
MAJOR criterion validation uses the declared G1-G6/M1-M7 set; MATERIAL does not qualify merely by an M prefix.

STRUCTURAL assessment returns partial_required/deadline to its existing analyst; the host no longer creates or handles an unplanned PUBLISH_PARTIAL publisher job. The analyst publishes through the normal validated tool.
scope_limits: The deadline is exposed and delivery latency remains measurable; the test does not claim unattended live 3-minute acceptance.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/runtime.py / src/tank/scheduler.py: no PUBLISH_PARTIAL job registration or publisher handler

findings.requirement: Reaction jobs use canonical event/token/checkpoint identity and an explicit six-hour post-run-after expiry; past checkpoints are scheduled immediately as retro captures.
scope_limits: Producer fields and expiry are source-inspected. Scheduler checkpoint capture/revision and retention regressions belong to runtime owner.

findings.requirement: Tool and scheduler use event:kind:due as one milestone identity; the tool expiry is max(due,now)+2h, and accepted Snapshot vote end metadata schedules exactly one milestone after event extraction.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/scheduler.py canonical MILESTONE_CHECK key and verified outcome request

findings.requirement: Accepted Snapshot source items with end metadata create a canonical vote-end milestone only after a real event exists.

Heavy MTA/decision history uses indexed latest-before queries and exact saved MTA/outlook references; current publication never scans all historical snapshots. First FULL/latest alert/latest SENT are bounded; small event histories use uncapped filtered keyset iteration.
scope_limits: The regression uses 1001 prior snapshots/decisions and a future poison snapshot, a guarded repository, and real PostgreSQL. This is a bounded-query correctness test, not a multi-week load acceptance claim.

findings.requirement: Actual SourceItem/event/EMS/decision/publication producers satisfy the forward-only typed PostgreSQL completeness constraints, including explicit time basis, gates, MTA linkage and trade reasons.
scope_limits: Table DDL, projections and enforcement belong to storage owner; test uses canonical synthetic fixtures and no external messages.

findings.requirement: Credential-bearing evidence URLs and known secret response bytes are refused before network/raw persistence; evidence hashes continue to identify unmodified accepted bytes.
scope_limits: Session tool-argument pre-ledger redaction is owned and tested separately by sessions owner.

findings.requirement: Requested HIGH requires an accepted verified primary/artifact claim supporting the event fact. Official-domain search snippets alone cannot establish HIGH; fetched official confirmation can, and unrelated verified facts cannot.
scope_limits: No separate semantic classifier or new calibration threshold is introduced. Agent claim semantics remain reviewable through quoted durable evidence.

findings.requirement: Ordinary material changes and stale-origin expiry notices freeze a pending card and defer delivery from last actual SENT rather than being refused and forgotten; newer pending cards do not postpone that deadline.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/delivery.py delivery-time rate/coalescence and urgent supersession

findings.requirement: Domain tools and review bundles keep full canonical MarketTruth and complete measurement metadata; only the SessionService wire view omits the duplicated index and points back to persisted records.
cross_owner_evidence: src/tank/agents/sessions.py deterministic wire projection / restart recovery tests

findings.requirement: Analyst skill must state the explicit 3-minute PARTIAL, 8-minute FULL and 60-second update limits.
findings.observed: Current skill item 7 references 01 §9 but does not spell out those three limits.
scope_limits: Configuration/deployment skill payload is outside event-tools source ownership. Root/config owner notified; no intentional-deviation claim.

findings.requirement: Tank data skill must include current search/filter endpoints and key-handling/shared sandbox venue-limit instructions.
findings.observed: Current guide includes source/market endpoint tables and a DuckDuckGo baseline header, but explicit TypeSafe/filter invocation, environment/key instructions and sandbox shares-of-venue-budget rule still need configuration-owner verification/completion. Tavily is retired by D9.
scope_limits: Source/market tables being present is not proof that every tank-data instruction is implemented. Config owner/root notified.

findings.requirement: Scout deployment must match its narrow skill/tool permissions and §10 write isolation.
findings.observed: Host event-tools guard limits scout calls to search/read/review and binds record_review to the proposal. Current prepare_openma payload still attaches tank-data and built-in sandbox tools to the scout; deployment/database-role isolation is owned elsewhere.
scope_limits: Host tool validation is not a claim that sandbox database permissions are isolated. Root/deploy owner must resolve the deployment clause.

findings.requirement: Analyst tools need informative deployed descriptions rather than placeholders.
findings.observed: Current tools.json still contains descriptions such as Tank get item; schema validation is complete, but those prose descriptions remain a configuration-owner task.
scope_limits: No claim that a complete input schema substitutes for a useful deployed tool description. Root notified.

findings.requirement: Exact §3.8 MarketTruth job priorities, per-token identities, retry limits, dependency and TTL independent of model call id.
scope_limits: Memory and actual PostgreSQL regression verifies two distinct model call IDs reuse completed jobs/results; a new token or cutoff minute creates a distinct truth run.
A previously completed escalation is not reset or reopened after demotion; no unplanned reactivation policy is introduced.
Explicit fractional requested cutoff is retained in the payload/result request metadata; idempotency uses its UTC minute and the returned MTA always exposes its actual persisted cutoff.

findings.requirement: Reaction token selection uses current analysis-set tokens plus BTC/ETH benchmarks, not every historical beneficiary edge.
scope_limits: Producer selection is source-inspected; if assessment precedes the first beneficiary map it uses current direct event tokens, and the scheduler subsequently schedules the completed analysis set. Scheduler capture/pack ID behavior belongs to runtime owner.
